full_text:
Article 7 (Matters to Be Stated in Accounting Reports, etc.)
(1) When submitting a written report (including an interim report) under Article 17 of the Act, the special prosecutor shall specifically state details of the progress of the investigation and trial, expenditures, activities and other relevant matters.
(2) Work-related documents, etc., kept under the main clause of Article 17 of the Act shall include the entirety of the investigation and trial records and all other documents, articles, etc. prepared or kept in the performance of duties by the special prosecutor, assistant special prosecutors, special investigators, public officials seconded pursuant to Article 7 (4) of the Act, or persons employed to assist the special prosecutor in the performance of duties.
(3) With respect to seized articles required to be returned following a disposition not to institute a prosecution or a court ruling, the special prosecutor shall complete the disposition of the seized articles or execution of the ruling pursuant to the Criminal Procedure Act and other relevant statutes and regulations before handing over work-related documents, etc., kept under the main clause of Article 17 of the Act to the Prosecutor General.
